messages.subject: ShinyApps Deployment Issue

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: ShinyApps Deployment Issue
parts:
Could you try placing the library calls on separate lines?

rsconnect attempts to determine the packages an application depends upon, and lists them in a manifest file that is uploaded. Perhaps there is a parsing issue with them all on one line.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: ShinyApps Deployment Issue
parts:
Well, the first problem I wanted to solve was the error "dependencies in this file will not be discovered." as that is likely related to the error about leaflet not being found.

shinyapps.io will attempt to run your application using the same locale rsconnect detected in your local environment. However that isn't always sufficient going from Windows (what you appear to be running) to Linux (what shinyapps.io runs). So you might have to perform your file operations and be explicitly about using UTF-8.
